selection.description: Applications made before 15 March at 12:00 are assessed in quota 2, where additional qualifications count as well as the required ones.

requirements.label: An IB Diploma, or DP Course Results with at least 18 points, grade 3 in all six subjects and three of them at HL

officialWording.text: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2.

requirements.note: The rule is national, not this institution's. The Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 or more in all six subjects and three at HL, like a two-year hf without overbygning, which gives access to erhvervsakademi and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2. This is an erhvervsakademiuddannelse (AP degree), which the Agency names directly. The institution's own page names the IB but says nothing about Course Results, so a Course candidate should confirm with admissions in writing. The award does not waive the subject requirements below.

requirements.label: Mathematics at C level or Economics at C level
English at B level, or an accepted English test

alternatives.label: An accepted English test instead (for example IELTS Academic 6.5)

officialWording.text: The language requirement is English at the Danish B-level [...] However, if you only fulfil the specific entry requirement of English at C level [...] then the language requirement can be satisfied with an English test. [...] IELTS Academic: 6,5

officialRequirementsText.text: English at the Danish C-level. [...] And Mathematics at the Danish C-level. [...] Or Economics at the Danish C-level. [...] The language requirement is English at the Danish B-level (at least 210 hours during the last three years of their upper-secondary education). However, if you only fulfil the specific entry requirement of English at C level, then the language requirement can be satisfied with an English test.

notes: An AP degree is a short-cycle qualification (EQF level 5), not a bachelor's degree.
The international line carries 10 extra ECTS in programming on top of the 120.
Non-EU tuition, valid from 2026: EUR 6,000 per semester, EUR 24,000 for the whole programme. The obligatory second-semester study trip costs about EUR 550.
Admission area number on optagelse.dk: 81565. Taught at Sønderhøj 30, Viby J (Aarhus).
